name: Cognitive Maze v2.0.1 - Authentic NPC Randomization & Robust Cloud Sync
notes: Version 2.0.1 — Authentic NPC Randomization & Resilience Update: Implements non-repetitive NPC randomization across stations up to 15 questions for Quarter 2, Quarter 3, and Summative Assessment while preserving Quarter 1's authentic original shape order; resolves ghost grade synchronization by thoroughly purging all student identifier aliases across local caches and cloud records; introduces non-blocking background cloud synchronization on student selection for zero UI stutter; adds safeguard to prevent headless automated test suites from writing dummy scores to live cloud database; ensures recorded completion dates persist reliably across quarters.
